title: Midterm 2
source: Four phone photos of a printed, graded exam (pages 1–4). Only the questions were transcribed; handwritten answers, grading marks and the score are not part of this site.

transcription.ocr: Windows built-in OCR (en-US) on contrast-enhanced, 2× upscaled photos. It recovered only fragments of the angled photos (for example “R3=5 ohm, R4=15 ohm”, “5.6uF”, “8.2uF”, “2 ms”, “= 4v, = 10v, 6v”), all consistent with the transcription.
transcription.visual: Every statement, value, unit, polarity mark and circuit connection was then verified visually on zoomed crops of each question, and checked again by an independent reviewer.
transcription.scope: The oscilloscope trace in question 5 was measured by pixel analysis against perspective-corrected grid lines (peaks +2.43 div, trough −2.64 div, period 4.98 div).
